name: nested-mem-1
question: With 4 GiB microVMs, does a nested c8i.4xlarge (16 vCPUs, 32 GiB) reach the same density as a nested m8i.4xlarge (16 vCPUs, 64 GiB), or does its memory run out first? If it keeps up, its lower price makes it cheaper per 1,000 tasks.

why.m8i-4xlarge: The cap-baseline-1 host, whose 64 GiB holds 4 GiB microVMs at every density tested here, so CPU alone should limit it, between 8 and 12 as before.
why.c8i-4xlarge: The same vCPUs with half the memory: if each microVM filled its 4 GiB, memory would run out near density 7, but cap-baseline-1's microVMs used about 0.7 GiB each, so CPU may limit it first.
